name: io.github.christianmatumona/treasury-risk-mcp
title: Treasury Risk Analyzer
description: Treasury risk, FX exposure, liquidity & payment decisions for AI CFO agents. Pay per call in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding a few USDC, used to sign per-call x402 payments. Without it, paid tools only validate input and quote the price.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call spending cap in USD (default 2.00). Tools priced above it are refused before signing.

environmentVariables.name: TREASURY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the service base URL (default: public production deployment).
